/audio/mapguess/kokoro-heart/mapguess-01.speechText: soundings. Definition: Measurements of how deep the water is. In this passage, soundings help a ship approach the island safely.
tottery. Definition: Shaky or unsteady. In this passage, the captain’s tottery handwriting differs from the neat writing on the map.
thimble. Definition: A small cap worn on a fingertip to protect it when pushing a sewing needle. In this passage, a thimble has been pressed into the seals on the packet.

/audio/mapguess/kokoro-heart/mapguess-02.speechText: vestige. Definition: A small remaining trace. In this passage, the map has not even a vestige of land.
equator. Definition: An imaginary line around the middle of Earth, halfway between the North and South Poles. In this passage, the crew dismisses the Equator and other reference lines shown on maps.

bowsprit. Definition: A long pole projecting forward from the front of a sailing ship, used to support sails and their rigging. In this passage, the bowsprit absurdly gets mixed up with the rudder at the back of the ship.

/audio/mapguess/kokoro-heart/mapguess-03.speechText: circumference. Definition: The distance around a circle or a round object. In this passage, Fogg travels around the circumference of Earth, which spans 360 degrees.
meridian. Definition: An imaginary north-to-south line through a place on Earth. In this passage, counting the sun’s passages across the meridian helps explain the day difference.
pecuniary. Definition: Relating to money. In this passage, Fogg’s pecuniary gain is small after his expenses.

/audio/mapguess/kokoro-heart/mapguess-04.speechText: stupefying. Definition: Making someone dull, dazed, or unable to think clearly. In this passage, Muir calls excessive work stupefying.
chaparral. Definition: Dense growth of shrubs and small trees, especially in regions with dry summers. In this passage, people brush through chaparral while exploring wild places.
sauntering. Definition: Walking slowly and without hurry. In this passage, people are sauntering through pinewoods as they enjoy nature.

/audio/mapguess/kokoro-heart/mapguess-05.speechText: projection. Definition: A method of representing Earth’s curved surface on a flat map. In this passage, each projection preserves some features better than others.
equidistant. Definition: Showing true distances along certain specified lines. In this passage, an equidistant map does not preserve every distance.
oblique. Definition: Slanting rather than parallel or at a right angle. In this passage, some regions run oblique to the Equator.

/audio/mapguess/kokoro-heart/mapguess-06.speechText: diverged. Definition: Separated and went in different directions. In this passage, two roads diverged in the woods.
wanted. Definition: Lacked or needed something. In this passage, the grassy road “wanted wear”: it seemed to need more use by travelers.
trodden. Definition: Pressed or worn by people walking. In this passage, neither road’s leaves have been trodden black that morning.

/audio/mapguess/kokoro-heart/mapguess-07.speechText: void. Definition: Completely lacking something. In this passage, no part of the river is void of interest.
reperusal. Definition: A second or repeated reading. In this passage, every reperusal of the river reveals something worth noticing.
grimmest. Definition: Most alarming or frighteningly serious. In this passage, the river’s signs are the grimmest reading because they can warn a pilot of deadly dangers.

/audio/mapguess/kokoro-heart/mapguess-08.speechText: augmentation. Definition: An addition that improves or increases something. In this passage, augmentation systems improve the accuracy of a position.
degrade. Definition: Make something less accurate or effective. In this passage, blocked signals can degrade GPS accuracy.
comply. Definition: Act according to a rule or requirement. In this passage, poorly designed devices may not comply with GPS specifications.
